jaw_semantics: One independent position per jaw: 0 closed, 0.0267 open. The left jaw mimics the right jaw on the opposite axis. CAD meshes are exported open.

camera.placement: Centre of four CAD mounting holes, normal to the mounting plate; assumed 4 mm lens protrusion. Approximate optical centre, not a measured camera calibration.

simulation: Body mass 0.25 kg and each jaw mass 0.03 kg are estimates. Coarse collision envelopes and position-actuator gains model the attachment, not its physical motor/compliance.
